questions.q: Where did the tide pool lie?
options: At the foot of a cliff
In the middle of flat open sand

questions.q: What did the silver fish do?
options: Darted out, circled the pool twice, and vanished back into shadow
Leapt over into the next pool
Chased the hermit crab across the sand

questions.q: What could you hear while the pool stayed perfectly still?
options: Waves breaking in slow rhythm farther out
